text:
amanda.c: Heads-up — I'm drafting the key rotation flow that touches AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and Azure Key Vault. Need input on RBAC window and compatibility with existing envelope headers.

raj.patel: 👍 thanks. two initial priorities: 1) ensure rewrap is idempotent (safe retries) 2) make audit logs searchable by old_key_id/new_key_id and correlation_id.

leon.hwang: For RBAC I propose a short-lived role `kms-rewraper` that can be granted only to the rewrap job service account. Grant duration = 24h, audited, and explicit allow-list for targets. Apply via terraform change + human approval.

mike.sanders: Canary plan: run rewrap on a single customer shard (2% of objects) for 48 hours. Metrics to watch: rewrap_failure_rate, read_latency_tail_p95, and mismatch_count (decrypted != expected). If failures > 0.5% abort.

amanda.c: That sounds good. On backwards compat: we currently have envelope header `enc_ver:1` — if we rotate to a new KEK scheme we should bump `enc_ver:2` and keep decryption support for v1 for 90 days. Older clients should continue to read v1. New writes default to v2 after canary.

raj.patel: Add a migration field `rewrap_correlation_id` to each object when rewrap starts. Also record `original_kek_id` and `rotated_kek_id` in audit log. That makes backfills and triage easier.

leon.hwang: Implementation sketch:
```
# pseudo CLI for the batch rewrap job
rewrap-run --source-bucket s3://redwood-data --selector shard=0 --kek-target alias/redwood-kek-v2 \
  --idempotency-key $RUN_ID --dry-run=false
```
Make sure each object's metadata gets `rewrap_correlation_id` before changing ciphertext.

security-bot: Checklist: [x] KMS key policy reviewed, [x] CMK rotation enabled (cloud provider), [ ] Audit export to SIEM configured, [ ] RBAC change reviewed by PAM.

mike.sanders: Observability needs: add a rewrap trace span (trace_id = rewrap_correlation_id) and log an audit event that includes caller identity and ticket/idempotency token. Export to Cloud Logging/CloudWatch/Sentinel.

amanda.c: Question on failure modes — if rewrap fails mid-object, what's the safe rollback?

raj.patel: Failures: 1) partial rewrap (metadata updated but ciphertext not swapped) — detect via status enum `rewrap_state` (PENDING -> IN_PROGRESS -> DONE/FAILED). Rewrap step must be atomic: write new ciphertext to temp key and then swap metadata in single DB txn. 2) cross-cloud KEK unavailability — fallback to synchronous decrypt via original KEK and put object read-only behind a flag, alert ops.

leon.hwang: On RBAC timing: we should rotate KEKs only after a successful rewrap canary and once audit export is fully enabled. Proposed schedule:
- Day 0: Deploy rewrap job + RBAC role staged (roles created but not granted)
- Day 1: Run dry-run canary on 2% (no writes)
- Day 3: Canary write on 2% (48h observation)
- Day 7: Ramp to 25% if stable
- Day 14: Full rollout and KEK rotate/disable old KEK policy

amanda.c: Sounds conservative — add a 24h post-rollout watch window for vuln triage. If any crypto-related vuln is found during the window, we freeze further rollouts and open an incident.

mike.sanders: Incident response note: if a KEK compromise is suspected, immediately revoke rewraper role grants, disable KEK usage (if supported) and set bucket/object read-only while we perform emergency re-encrypt to new KEK. Have a pre-baked playbook and runbook with checklist and on-call contacts.

raj.patel: Small nit — ensure every audit entry contains `caller_identity`, `service_account`, `correlation_id`, `old_kek_sha256`, `new_kek_sha256`. SIEM rules should alert on any rewraps by unexpected principals.

amanda.c: One last thing — compatibility tests. We need unit+integration tests that simulate: old client reading v2, new client reading v1, and cross-cloud decrypts. Put tests in CI gate and block merges to `main` until passing.

deploy-bot: deploy status: rewrap-job:v1.3 queued for canary shard. ETA 01:30 UTC.

leon.hwang: I'll produce a short PR with terraform changes for `kms-rewraper` role and a draft of the runbook. Posting it in #eng-infra for review.

amanda.c: Thanks — I'll update the audit log schema doc and add the `rewrap_correlation_id` field. We'll sync tomorrow 10am PT for final sign-off. :white_check_mark:
